description: Run MeTube — a yt-dlp web UI — in Docker on the remote, bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8081 (reached only over the SSH tunnel). Missing pieces are installed for you: curl, Docker, and the daemon itself. Paste a video/playlist URL in the web UI and yt-dlp downloads it on the server into ~/yt-dlp-downloads, merged to mp4. Inspired by a Docker yt-dlp setup.

steps.description: Check this server can install things unattended: root without a password prompt, or Docker already running for this account.
steps.run: echo "Docker does not run for this account, and the account cannot become root without a password prompt, so nothing can be installed. Recipe steps run on an SSH channel with no terminal, so sudo has nowhere to ask for a password and would wait forever instead of prompting. Connect as root, give this user passwordless sudo, or add it to the docker group, then run setup again." >&2; exit 1

steps.description: Install curl if the server has neither curl nor wget — the Docker installer is downloaded with one of them. Skipped if either is already there; best-effort, so setup carries on if it fails.
steps.run: SUDO=; [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || SUDO="sudo -n"; echo "Installing curl (this server has neither curl nor wget)..."; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=120 update </dev/null; $SUDO env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=120 -y install curl ca-certificates </dev/null; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO dnf -y install curl ca-certificates </dev/null; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO yum -y install curl ca-certificates </dev/null; elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO zypper --non-interactive install curl ca-certificates </dev/null; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO pacman -Sy --noconfirm curl ca-certificates </dev/null; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO apk add --no-cache curl ca-certificates </dev/null; else echo "No apt-get, dnf, yum, zypper, pacman or apk here to install curl with." >&2; exit 1; fi; command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "curl still is not on PATH. Setup carries on: this only blocks the Docker install, which is skipped when Docker is already there." >&2; exit 1; }; echo "curl installed."

steps.description: Install Docker if it isn't already: the official get.docker.com script, falling back to this distro's own docker package. Skipped if docker is present.
steps.run: SUDO=; [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || SUDO="sudo -n"; d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; echo "Fetching get.docker.com..."; if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o "$d/get-docker.sh"; else wget -qO "$d/get-docker.sh" https://get.docker.com; fi; if [ -s "$d/get-docker.sh" ]; then printf 'DPkg::Lock::Timeout "120";\n' > "$d/apt.conf"; echo "Installing Docker. The installer runs apt quietly, so expect a few minutes with no further output."; $SUDO env APT_CONFIG="$d/apt.conf" DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 sh "$d/get-docker.sh" </dev/null; else echo "Could not download the Docker installer." >&2; fi; rm -rf "$d"; if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "get.docker.com did not install Docker here; trying this distro's own package..."; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=120 update </dev/null; $SUDO env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=120 -y install docker.io </dev/null; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO dnf -y install docker </dev/null; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO yum -y install docker </dev/null; elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO zypper --non-interactive install docker </dev/null; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO pacman -Sy --noconfirm docker </dev/null; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then $SUDO apk add --no-cache docker </dev/null; fi; fi; command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Docker could not be installed on this server." >&2; exit 1; }; $SUDO usermod -aG docker "$(id -un)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "Docker installed."

steps.description: Start the Docker daemon and enable it at boot. Skipped if Docker already answers.
steps.run: SUDO=; [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || SUDO="sudo -n"; echo "Starting the Docker daemon..."; $SUDO systemctl enable --now docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || { $SUDO rc-update add docker default >/dev/null 2>&1; $SUDO rc-service docker start >/dev/null 2>&1; } || $SUDO service docker start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; for i in $(seq 1 30); do { docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || $SUDO docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; } && { echo "Docker daemon is up."; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; echo "Docker is installed but its daemon is not answering. Start it on the server (systemctl start docker), then run setup again." >&2; exit 1

steps.description: Start the MeTube container: web UI on 127.0.0.1:8081, downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads, merged to mp4.
steps.check: docker ps --filter name=metube --filter status=running -q 2>/dev/null | grep -q . || sudo -n docker ps --filter name=metube --filter status=running -q 2>/dev/null | grep -q .
steps.run: DK=docker; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || DK="sudo -n docker"; mkdir -p "$HOME/yt-dlp-downloads"; $DK rm -f metube >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "Pulling the MeTube image..."; $DK pull ghcr.io/alexta69/metube || exit 1; echo "Starting the container..."; $DK run -d --name metube --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:8081:8081 -v "$HOME/yt-dlp-downloads:/downloads" -e PUID=$(id -u) -e PGID=$(id -g) -e YTDL_OPTIONS='{"merge_output_format":"mp4"}' ghcr.io/alexta69/metube

steps.description: Wait for MeTube to finish starting.
steps.run: if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then GET="curl -fsS -o /dev/null"; elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then GET="wget -q -O /dev/null"; else echo "No curl or wget here to probe with - the container is started; open MeTube in a moment."; exit 0; fi; echo "Waiting for MeTube to answer on 127.0.0.1:8081..."; for i in $(seq 1 60); do $GET http://127.0.0.1:8081/ 2>/dev/null && { echo "MeTube is up."; exit 0; }; sleep 2; done; echo "MeTube is still starting - give it a moment, then open it."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the MeTube container. Your downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads are kept.
uninstall.run: DK=docker; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || DK="sudo -n docker"; $DK rm -f metube >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "MeTube container removed; downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads are kept."
